!1 Login page accessibility

The login page is opened and checked against WCAG 2.1 level AA with axe-core. `max violations` is how many findings are
allowed before the page fails; the sample login screen has 2 known ones (a select without a label and a missing `lang`
attribute), so it is set to 2 here. Set it to 0 to enforce. Open the `report?` link for every finding and how to fix it.
